remarks:
1298 Bloomingdale Road, Basom, NY – Country Charm with Room to Make It Your Own!

Discover the potential of this country property situated on just under 3 acres, offering a peaceful rural setting with convenient access to the interstate. This traditional Montgomery Home features 3 bedrooms with the possibility of a 4th bedroom or home office, 1 full bathroom, convenient first-floor laundry, and a wraparound enclosed porch offering additional space to enjoy the country surroundings.

While the home would benefit from cosmetic updates and personal touches, several important improvements have already been completed! Updates include a new furnace and hot water tank, updated electrical service, roof replacement completed in stages (east half in 2016 and west half in 2024), and rebuilt soffits in 2023.

The enclosed front and side porch features unique construction, supported in part by two deep reinforced concrete silo blocks. The porch roof may require some attention, presenting an additional opportunity for improvements.

Interior flooring includes a combination of carpeting and vinyl, with opportunities to refresh and customize the living spaces to your taste.

With nearly 3 acres of land, a charming country setting, and numerous improvements already completed, this property offers an appealing opportunity for buyers looking to bring their vision to life. Bring your ideas and a little elbow grease to unlock the possibilities this country property has to offer!

House is being sold AS-IS. Delayed negotiations until Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 12:00 Noon.
